An '''electrostatic repeller''', also known as a '''sand trap''', was a device that generated a static field to repel airborne particles such as sand and dust from ramps, doorways and walkways. The [[Lars family/Legends|Lars family]] used electrostatic repellers at their [[Lars homestead/Legends|homestead]] on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].
